{"reason": "Lowered the forecast-bias threshold 0.1→0.05 and added market-signal-mismatch? as a demand-error trigger: the 8 shown failure rows (bias 0.065–0.081, amounts 45k–254k) were all 'unknown' but truly demand-forecast-error. The supplier branch stays first, so supplier-delay rows are unchanged; unknown=23 should fall and recovered amount rise.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
         (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05)))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
